title: Page 43
transc:
Ft. Monroe Mar 17 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Brutus We can find on our
maps no such patron as Fords Patent
zebra Bottoms Longs and Jones patrons are
all the patents below the York windsor
welch we know of zodiac will find
the value torch sweden at once unity
What is most Tarquin here is stagger
draft ironclads to hold the windpipe zebra 
call attention of the Navy to that
Pekin if they can hold the windsor
we can hold the land zodiac Shall
ask for officers soon Yoke Knave Lucy
Geo D Sheldon


Norfolk Mar 17. 1864
Maj Eckert Di
I change words Tappan to Orphian
Shelter to Endless Taunton to France
Shelby to Sigel Lewis to season
Wallace to submit and make Taunton
and shelter stand for H W
Halleck Ireland & Italy stand opposite
General in chief as before answer
R OBrien
